entries.title: Frog model T4 complete shared-site block screening and harmonic exit estimator (w677 C37 numerical)
entries.statement: OWNER-OWN-WORK DRAFT; C37 v1 numerical evidence only, novelty unassessed. Complete T4 blocks keep all within-episode shared discoveries but reset on exits. Height2 connected-subset formulas give best bulk spectral radius about1.257323. Harmonic-site Monte Carlo at heights2-6 gives estimates 1.2543, 1.3032, 1.3451, 1.4002, 1.5232. These estimates are unfavorable. The finite-block exit weight at level j is (4^(L+1-j)-1)/(4^(L+2)-1); summing it over awakened residents and seed frogs estimates the mean upward exit count. Its unbiasedness uses each resident path being unused before waking. Bars are descriptive, no floating error enclosure or rare-tail bound is provided, and the candidate infinite comparison remains unaudited. No all-height obstruction, threshold, ordinary T4 transience, or recurrence conclusion follows.
